explanation:
In this reaction, carbon (C) is oxidized from an oxidation state of 0 in elemental carbon to +4 in carbon dioxide (CO2). Simultaneously, the nitrogen in nitric acid (HNO3) is reduced, changing from an oxidation state of +5 to +4 in nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and +2 in nitric oxide (NO). Because nitric acid accepts electrons from carbon, causing the carbon to be oxidized, it functions as the oxidizing agent.
